description: Use this when asked whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works, is reachable, is valid or has changed. Pass its `url`. Returns a one-line verdict (READY, FIXES_NEEDED, NO_AGENT_CARD or UNREACHABLE), fixes, dated history when GAIP observes it, and a receipt. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

intended_task.description: Optional: what you plan to hand it, e.g. 'weather forecast for London'. Adds task-specific evidence.

url.description: Public https link to the agent, its A2A agent card, MCP server endpoint or OpenAPI document. GAIP fetches, validates and reach-tests it.

name: gaip_check
title: Check an AI agent, MCP server or API
